summary: In the conceptual design meeting, the team agreed on an iPod-style scroll-wheel interface without an integrated screen, utilizing the television for on-screen menus to avoid expensive advanced chips. The physical casing will incorporate a trendy fruit-and-vegetable theme using spongy stress-ball rubber for tactile comfort and interchangeable colored covers, while rejecting titanium and solar cells due to material incompatibilities. Industrial Designer and User Interface Designer were tasked with creating physical clay mockups, and Marketing will prepare the product evaluation framework before the next meeting.
decisions: Excluded a dedicated remote LCD screen in favor of on-screen television menu display
Selected a regular-grade chip suitable for iPod-style scroll-wheel input without excess cost
Adopted spongy stress-ball rubber material with interchangeable fruit-themed covers
Rejected titanium casing and solar energy due to weight and rubber casing incompatibility
Standardized core components including buttons, circuit board casing, and iPod-style scroll-wheel

action_items.task: Create physical modeling clay mockups for the remote look-and-feel and interface layout
Prepare product evaluation framework for the conceptual design options
